def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    n = len(bins)
    priorities = np.full(n, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    if not np.any(valid_mask):
        return priorities
    indices = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    fit_count = np.floor(bins[valid_mask] / item).astype(np.float64)
    decay_factor = np.exp(-0.08 * indices[valid_mask])
    priorities[valid_mask] = fit_count * decay_factor
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.

    remainder = bins % item
    tie_break = bins * 1e-10
    return np.where(bins >= item, -remainder + tie_break, -np.inf)
